I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 25 November. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. Marcus is a member of #north-team, so this is something he could already see. A renewal date is an account detail, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.

One thing to flag: the channel shows that my wrap-up note from Ilse's request was posted in #north-team as a separate message rather than in her thread. It contains nothing sensitive, but it is channel clutter.
